lines.t: Verse 1
The world can offer all its treasures,
Every comfort, every gain,
It can promise easy roads
With no sorrow, no pain.
But when I look beyond the glitter,
Past the things that fade away,
I see a road that leads to life—
And I hear You call my name.
Chorus
I could have worldly riches,
But what good would they do?
I could choose the wide path,
But what is that against Your truth?
Silver and gold, though they shine bright,
Could never top Your love and grace
Shining through the night.
(Instrumental break)
Verse 2
I could chase the praise of people,
I could live for what they see,
I could build my life on treasures
That were never meant for me.
I could choose a life of comfort,
Turn my heart from what is true,
But what would I gain from all the world
If I lost my life with You?
Chorus
I could have worldly riches,
But what good would they do?
I could choose the wide path,
But what is that against Your truth?
Silver and gold, though they shine bright,
Could never top Your love and grace
Shining through the night.
Bridge
Let the world keep its treasures,
Let it keep its empty praise.
Let it promise me tomorrow,
Let it call me from Your way.
For my heart has found its treasure,
And my soul knows where it's home.
I'd rather have You, YahuShua,
Than all the world could ever own.
Final Chorus
I could have worldly riches,
But what good would they do?
I could choose the wide path,
But what is that against Your truth?
Silver and gold, though they shine bright,
Could never top Your love and grace
Shining through the night.
Outro
So I will follow You, YahuShua.
You're all I need to know.
